known.via: English Wikipedia "Romagna Albana" (a wine place on Wikidata)

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A white wine appellation of Emilia-Romagna, made principally from Albana in Bologna, Forlì-Cesena and Ravenna, and including wine from raisined grapes. It was awarded DOC status in 1967 and DOCG status in 1987.
